title: AI Just Reached Gold-Medal Level at the Math Olympiad 🥇 #Shorts
description:
A year ago, AI missed a math-olympiad gold medal by a single point. This year, it earned gold-medal level.

At the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad, an advanced version of Google DeepMind's Gemini ("Deep Think") solved 5 of the 6 hardest math problems on Earth — scoring 35 out of 42, exactly the gold-medal cutoff, inside the same 4.5-hour limit as the students. This time it wrote full proofs in plain English (in 2024 it needed problems translated into code and only reached silver, 28/42). Its answers were officially graded by the IMO.

Honest context: it reached gold-medal standard — an AI can't actually be awarded a medal, and dozens of human contestants still scored higher. It also failed the hardest problem (Problem 6). This isn't "AI beat the students" or AGI.

Sources:
• Google DeepMind — Gemini Deep Think achieves gold-medal standard at the IMO (Jul 21, 2025)
• UKMT / BMOS — IMO 2025 results (Jul 18, 2025)
• Gary Marcus — analysis of the IMO results (Jul 2025)

#Shorts #AI #math #IMO #deepmind #gemini #machinelearning #science #STEM
